subject: Long flights shift the gut microbiome, not just sleep
script: From Agewell Brief: Long flights shift the gut microbiome, not just sleep. Long flights disrupt more than sleep—your gut bacteria may also feel the time change, leading to fatigue and digestive issues. Jet lag affects your gut microbiome, not just your sleep. Gut disruption can cause fatigue and digestive discomfort. Plan ahead to help your gut adjust to new time zones. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
